WEBVTT

NOTE language en-US

00:00:00.040 --> 00:00:02.982
Wiz Khalifa is facing backlash after sharing a video of

00:00:03.036 --> 00:00:04.160
a birthday tradition.

00:00:04.600 --> 00:00:07.629
In the clip, the See You Again singer punches his

00:00:07.690 --> 00:00:10.040
son Sebastian in the stomach 13 times.

00:00:10.400 --> 00:00:13.190
He tells Sebastian to raise his arms above his head

00:00:13.245 --> 00:00:15.160
for each punch, one for every year.

00:00:15.520 --> 00:00:18.245
Sebastian grimaces and at one point tries to grab the

00:00:18.297 --> 00:00:19.119
wall behind him.

00:00:19.600 --> 00:00:20.240
Wiz wrote.

00:00:20.560 --> 00:00:23.982
We still doing birthday licks in this house and added

00:00:24.046 --> 00:00:25.080
took it like AG.

00:00:25.079 --> 00:00:29.418
Though the post drew mixed reactions, including comments threatening to

00:00:29.479 --> 00:00:31.679
call police and CPS for child abuse.
